verdict.rationale: The SDK documents arbitrary shell command execution via sandbox.exec(), with stdout/stderr/exit codes, streaming output, background processes and bash sessions, inside a full Linux container. Package installation is only implied by the full Linux environment and the shell access; no doc explicitly shows installing packages. missing for 10: explicit documentation of package installation (e.g. pip/npm/apt install) and its persistence, independent hands-on corroboration of command execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run arbitrary shell commands and install packages inside the sandbox

citations.quote: sandbox.exec() - Execute shell commands in the sandbox and capture stdout, stderr, and exit codes.
Execute commands and manage background processes in the sandbox's isolated container environment.
Sessions are bash shell execution contexts within a sandbox.
Each sandbox runs in its own isolated container with a full Linux environment
